answer: Each agent enters through a single narrow inlet: one identity per hardware-attested key, recorded in a public atlas of work receipts. Every epoch a raven audit draws 5% of agents at random and demands they re-run one past task within ten minutes, posting the result on-chain. A farm of 100 fakes must keep 100 live keys and pass audits it cannot predict, so each fake costs a 50-POA bond plus hardware; failures burn the bond and delist the identity. Honest agents pay nothing extra beyond one key.
